name: Provider Prompt Shapes
author: Genlock Community
description: Editable prompt structures tuned to the way major image and video providers interpret prompts.

snippets.name: GPT Image 2
snippets.description: OpenAI's background-first visual brief for generation, editing, typography, and multi-reference work.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Scene / background: [ENVIRONMENT, TIME, LIGHTING]
Subject: [WHO OR WHAT, POSE OR ACTION]
Important details: [MATERIALS, TEXTURES, CAMERA, COMPOSITION, MOOD]
Use case: [EDITORIAL, PRODUCT, POSTER, STORYBOARD, OR OTHER OUTPUT]
Exact text: ["COPY" + PLACEMENT, FONT STYLE, SIZE, COLOR — OR NONE]
References: [ROLE OF EACH IMAGE]
Change: [DIRECT EDIT — WHEN EDITING]
Preserve: [IDENTITY, COMPOSITION, PRODUCT, OR OTHER LOCKED DETAILS]
Constraints: [NO EXTRA TEXT, NO WATERMARKS, NO LABELS UNLESS REQUESTED; OTHER HARD LIMITS]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Scene / background: [ENVIRONMENT, TIME, LIGHTING]
Subject: [WHO OR WHAT, POSE OR ACTION]
Important details: [MATERIALS, TEXTURES, CAMERA, COMPOSITION, MOOD]
Use case: [EDITORIAL, PRODUCT, POSTER, STORYBOARD, OR OTHER OUTPUT]
Exact text: ["COPY" + PLACEMENT, FONT STYLE, SIZE, COLOR — OR NONE]
References: [ROLE OF EACH IMAGE]
Change: [DIRECT EDIT — WHEN EDITING]
Preserve: [IDENTITY, COMPOSITION, PRODUCT, OR OTHER LOCKED DETAILS]
Constraints: [NO EXTRA TEXT, NO WATERMARKS, NO LABELS UNLESS REQUESTED; OTHER HARD LIMITS]
snippets.guidance: Use clear natural language rather than keyword stacking. Build complex results in stages; use Thinking mode for typography or multi-element compositions. For edits, keep Change and Preserve explicit.

snippets.name: Nano Banana / Gemini Image
snippets.description: Google's narrative image shape for generation, conversational edits, text, and multi-reference composition.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Subject: [SPECIFIC PERSON, OBJECT, OR PRODUCT]
Action: [POSE, GESTURE, OR CHANGE]
Location / context: [PLACE, SITUATION, BACKGROUND]
Composition / camera: [FRAMING, ANGLE, LENS, DEPTH]
Lighting: [SOURCE, DIRECTION, QUALITY, COLOR]
Materials / textures: [CONCRETE SURFACE AND FABRIC DETAILS]
Style: [VISUAL MEDIUM OR PHOTOGRAPHIC CHARACTER]
Exact text: ["COPY" + TYPOGRAPHY AND PLACEMENT — OR NONE]
References: [ROLE AND RELATIONSHIP OF EACH IMAGE]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Subject: [SPECIFIC PERSON, OBJECT, OR PRODUCT]
Action: [POSE, GESTURE, OR CHANGE]
Location / context: [PLACE, SITUATION, BACKGROUND]
Composition / camera: [FRAMING, ANGLE, LENS, DEPTH]
Lighting: [SOURCE, DIRECTION, QUALITY, COLOR]
Materials / textures: [CONCRETE SURFACE AND FABRIC DETAILS]
Style: [VISUAL MEDIUM OR PHOTOGRAPHIC CHARACTER]
Exact text: ["COPY" + TYPOGRAPHY AND PLACEMENT — OR NONE]
References: [ROLE AND RELATIONSHIP OF EACH IMAGE]
snippets.guidance: Use a narrative description and positive framing. Assign every reference image a role. Make complex edits through small, precise follow-ups instead of changing everything at once.

snippets.name: FLUX.2
snippets.description: Black Forest Labs' positive-only prose structure for the FLUX.2 image family.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Subject: [PRIMARY SUBJECT, FRONT-LOADED]
Action / pose: [VISIBLE ACTION OR BODY LANGUAGE]
Style / medium: [PHOTOGRAPHY, ILLUSTRATION, MATERIAL, OR PROCESS]
Context / setting: [LOCATION AND SURROUNDING DETAILS]
Lighting: [SOURCE, QUALITY, DIRECTION, SURFACE INTERACTION]
Camera / technical: [CAMERA, LENS, SETTINGS, FILM STOCK, COMPOSITION]
Exact text: ["COPY" + FONT HIERARCHY AND PLACEMENT — OR NONE]
Color anchors: [NAMED OR HEX COLORS WHEN ACCURACY MATTERS]
Desired state: [POSITIVE DESCRIPTION OF THE CLEAN FINAL FRAME]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Subject: [PRIMARY SUBJECT, FRONT-LOADED]
Action / pose: [VISIBLE ACTION OR BODY LANGUAGE]
Style / medium: [PHOTOGRAPHY, ILLUSTRATION, MATERIAL, OR PROCESS]
Context / setting: [LOCATION AND SURROUNDING DETAILS]
Lighting: [SOURCE, QUALITY, DIRECTION, SURFACE INTERACTION]
Camera / technical: [CAMERA, LENS, SETTINGS, FILM STOCK, COMPOSITION]
Exact text: ["COPY" + FONT HIERARCHY AND PLACEMENT — OR NONE]
Color anchors: [NAMED OR HEX COLORS WHEN ACCURACY MATTERS]
Desired state: [POSITIVE DESCRIPTION OF THE CLEAN FINAL FRAME]
snippets.guidance: Write natural visual prose and front-load the subject. FLUX.2 does not use negative prompts; replace exclusions with a positive description of the desired state. Klein favors speed, Pro or Max quality, and Flex typography.

snippets.name: Midjourney
snippets.description: A concise subject-first Midjourney shape with model controls kept at the end.
snippets.prompt_shape: [PRIMARY SUBJECT], [SPECIFIC SUBJECT DETAILS AND ACTION], [CONTEXT OR SETTING], [STYLE AND MOOD], [LIGHTING, CAMERA, LENS, COMPOSITION] [--ar ASPECT] [--stylize VALUE] [--style raw WHEN NEEDED] [--chaos VALUE WHEN NEEDED] [--weird VALUE WHEN NEEDED] [--sref STYLE REFERENCE] [--cref OR --oref CONSISTENCY REFERENCE]
snippets.promptModifiers: [PRIMARY SUBJECT], [SPECIFIC SUBJECT DETAILS AND ACTION], [CONTEXT OR SETTING], [STYLE AND MOOD], [LIGHTING, CAMERA, LENS, COMPOSITION] [--ar ASPECT] [--stylize VALUE] [--style raw WHEN NEEDED] [--chaos VALUE WHEN NEEDED] [--weird VALUE WHEN NEEDED] [--sref STYLE REFERENCE] [--cref OR --oref CONSISTENCY REFERENCE]
snippets.guidance: Keep the prose concise and put the important subject first because earlier words carry more weight. Add parameters after the natural-language scene; use reference parameters for consistency.

snippets.name: Grok Image
snippets.description: Direct image generation, edit, and multi-image composite instructions for Grok.
snippets.prompt_shape:
[SUBJECT] + [ACTION OR REQUESTED CHANGE] + [SETTING] + [ONE STYLE ANCHOR] + [LIGHTING]

References / preservation: [NAME WHAT COMES FROM EACH SOURCE AND WHAT MUST STAY UNCHANGED]
snippets.promptModifiers:
[SUBJECT] + [ACTION OR REQUESTED CHANGE] + [SETTING] + [ONE STYLE ANCHOR] + [LIGHTING]

References / preservation: [NAME WHAT COMES FROM EACH SOURCE AND WHAT MUST STAY UNCHANGED]
snippets.guidance: State the transformation directly. For composites, name which person, product, or wardrobe comes from each source. Do not repeat unchanged details unless preservation is critical.

snippets.name: Grok Video
snippets.description: A concise motion-led structure for Grok text, image-to-video, and reference-video generation.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Shot: [FRAMING]
Camera: [ONE CAMERA MOVEMENT]
Subject: [IDENTITY OR REFERENCE ANCHOR]
Motion beat: [ONE MAIN ACTION]
Environment: [SETTING AND ATMOSPHERE]
Lighting: [LIGHTING]
Tone: [TONE OR SINGLE STYLE ANCHOR]
References: [USE <IMAGE_1>, <IMAGE_2> WHEN NEEDED]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Shot: [FRAMING]
Camera: [ONE CAMERA MOVEMENT]
Subject: [IDENTITY OR REFERENCE ANCHOR]
Motion beat: [ONE MAIN ACTION]
Environment: [SETTING AND ATMOSPHERE]
Lighting: [LIGHTING]
Tone: [TONE OR SINGLE STYLE ANCHOR]
References: [USE <IMAGE_1>, <IMAGE_2> WHEN NEEDED]
snippets.guidance: Keep one scene and one main motion beat. Reference images influence identity, wardrobe, or products; they are not exact storyboards.

snippets.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 · Text to Video
snippets.description: The full HunyuanVideo formula for generating a scene from text.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Subject: [WHO OR WHAT]
Motion: [ORDERED SUBJECT ACTION]
Scene: [LOCATION, TIME, WEATHER]
Shot type: [FRAMING AND ANGLE]
Camera movement: [TRANSLATION, ROTATION, OR LENS MOVE]
Lighting: [STYLE, DIRECTION, QUALITY, SHADOWS, COLOR TEMPERATURE]
Style: [ONE VISUAL STYLE]
Atmosphere: [TEXTURE, WEATHER, MOOD]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Subject: [WHO OR WHAT]
Motion: [ORDERED SUBJECT ACTION]
Scene: [LOCATION, TIME, WEATHER]
Shot type: [FRAMING AND ANGLE]
Camera movement: [TRANSLATION, ROTATION, OR LENS MOVE]
Lighting: [STYLE, DIRECTION, QUALITY, SHADOWS, COLOR TEMPERATURE]
Style: [ONE VISUAL STYLE]
Atmosphere: [TEXTURE, WEATHER, MOOD]
snippets.guidance: Order actions temporally and treat lighting as atmosphere. Use the exact movement family you mean: dolly is not zoom; pan is not truck.

snippets.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 · Image to Video
snippets.description: A motion-only HunyuanVideo shape that lets the source frame own appearance.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Subject motion dynamics: [HOW THE EXISTING SUBJECT MOVES, IN ORDER]
Scene motion dynamics: [WIND, WATER, FABRIC, LIGHT, BACKGROUND MOVEMENT]
Camera movement: [ONE PRECISE MOVE AND ITS ENDING FRAME]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Subject motion dynamics: [HOW THE EXISTING SUBJECT MOVES, IN ORDER]
Scene motion dynamics: [WIND, WATER, FABRIC, LIGHT, BACKGROUND MOVEMENT]
Camera movement: [ONE PRECISE MOVE AND ITS ENDING FRAME]
snippets.guidance: Describe motion, not appearance—the source image already defines appearance.

snippets.name: LTX-2
snippets.description: A focused six-part LTX-2 structure with synchronized audio direction.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Shot: [CINEMATOGRAPHY AND FRAMING]
Scene: [LIGHTING, COLOR, TEXTURE, ATMOSPHERE]
Action: [NATURAL BEGINNING-TO-END SEQUENCE]
Characters: [VISIBLE PHYSICAL CUES, WARDROBE, EXPRESSION]
Camera: [STATIC OR ONE PRECISE MOVEMENT; DESCRIBE WHAT IT REVEALS]
Audio: [AMBIENCE, MUSIC TEXTURE, SPEECH OR SINGING]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Shot: [CINEMATOGRAPHY AND FRAMING]
Scene: [LIGHTING, COLOR, TEXTURE, ATMOSPHERE]
Action: [NATURAL BEGINNING-TO-END SEQUENCE]
Characters: [VISIBLE PHYSICAL CUES, WARDROBE, EXPRESSION]
Camera: [STATIC OR ONE PRECISE MOVEMENT; DESCRIBE WHAT IT REVEALS]
Audio: [AMBIENCE, MUSIC TEXTURE, SPEECH OR SINGING]
snippets.guidance: If the camera is static, include no camera movement, focus change, or zoom. LTX rewards a compact prompt with five or six important elements.

snippets.name: Seedance 2.0
snippets.description: The eight-component Seedance structure for cinematic, multi-shot, reference-conditioned video.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Shot / framing: [SHOT TYPE AND ANGLE]
Camera movement: [PRECISE MOVE]
Subject identity: [REPEATABLE PHYSICAL IDENTITY ANCHOR]
Action beats: [ONE BEAT PER SENTENCE OR SHOT 1 / SHOT 2]
Setting: [LOCATION, ERA, WEATHER, TIME]
Lighting / palette: [ONE COMMITTED LIGHTING IDEA]
Style / grade / era: [LENS, GRADE, FILM TEXTURE]
Audio: [AMBIENCE, DIEGETIC SOUND, TEXTURAL MUSIC, SHORT QUOTED DIALOGUE]
snippets.promptModifiers:
Shot / framing: [SHOT TYPE AND ANGLE]
Camera movement: [PRECISE MOVE]
Subject identity: [REPEATABLE PHYSICAL IDENTITY ANCHOR]
Action beats: [ONE BEAT PER SENTENCE OR SHOT 1 / SHOT 2]
Setting: [LOCATION, ERA, WEATHER, TIME]
Lighting / palette: [ONE COMMITTED LIGHTING IDEA]
Style / grade / era: [LENS, GRADE, FILM TEXTURE]
Audio: [AMBIENCE, DIEGETIC SOUND, TEXTURAL MUSIC, SHORT QUOTED DIALOGUE]
snippets.guidance: For multi-shot prompts, repeat the complete identity anchor in every shot. Keep quoted dialogue short for reliable lip-sync.

snippets.name: Sora 2
snippets.description: Sora's prose-first scene description followed by cinematography and action blocks.
snippets.prompt_shape:
[PROSE SCENE DESCRIPTION — CHARACTERS, COSTUMES, SCENERY, WEATHER, PRODUCTION DETAILS]

Cinematography:
Camera shot: [FRAMING AND ANGLE]
Lens: [FOCAL LENGTH, TYPE, OPTIONAL FILTRATION]
Lighting: [KEY, FILL, RIM, PRACTICALS, COLOR TEMPERATURE]
Mood: [OVERALL TONE]

Actions:
- [BEAT 1]
- [BEAT 2]
- [BEAT 3 OR REACTION]

Dialogue / background sound:
[SHORT NATURAL LINES AND DIEGETIC SOUND]

snippets.name: Veo 3.1 / Veo 3
snippets.description: Veo's comprehensive production shape including audio, optical effects, editing terms, and negatives.
snippets.prompt_shape:
Subject: [WHO OR WHAT]
Action: [MOVEMENT, INTERACTION, EXPRESSION]
Scene / context: [LOCATION, TIME, WEATHER, PERIOD]
Camera angle: [SHOT TYPE AND PERSPECTIVE]
Camera movement: [DOLLY, TRUCK, PEDESTAL, PAN, TILT, ROLL OR ZOOM]
Lens / optical effect: [FOCAL LENGTH, FOCUS BEHAVIOR, DISTORTION]
Lighting: [SOURCE, DIRECTION, QUALITY]
Tone / mood: [EMOTIONAL REGISTER]
Artistic style: [PHOTOREAL, CINEMATIC, ANIMATION OR ART MOVEMENT]
Ambiance: [PALETTE, ATMOSPHERE, TEXTURE]
Temporal rhythm: [PACING OR TIME EFFECT]
Audio: [SFX, AMBIENCE, MUSIC, DIALOGUE]
Cinematic terms: [OPTIONAL EDITING TECHNIQUE]
Negative: [EXCLUSIONS; INCLUDE NO SUBTITLES OR TEXT WHEN NEEDED]
